correctness.rationale: Finite exhaustive proof: a least-unmatched-vertex recurrence enumerates all 32 perfect matchings and checks the absence of a three-cover; 35,960 unordered four-subsets yield exactly 200 covers; 3-subset indexing yields all 220 exchange edges and exact component/isomorphism checks give the four classes totaling 42 components. An algorithmically independent four-color local CSP enumerates 400 normalized assignments, two per unordered cover, and agrees on 200 covers, 220 edges and every component profile. Actual standalone programs and certificate are included; no infinite generalization is inferred.

value.rationale: For a canonical first nontrivial flower snark whose cover index four was already known, an exact classification of optimum-cover moves answers a natural robustness/reconfiguration question. Ten covers admit no feasible single-matching replacement at all and the remaining covers split into 32 further components of three small types. These structural obstructions are invisible to the published index and general flow-characterization results, and can inform local-search behavior; the exact isolated-cover and component counts constitute a motivated finite invariant, not a routine restatement of the known existence theorem.
